name: @keli-wen/planar
description: A shared map of the work you do with agents — quietly reads local agent sessions into lines of work over time for planning, reflection, and personal agent context.
author: Keli Wen

scripts.app:install: npm run app:build && rm -rf /Applications/Planar.app && cp -R target/release/bundle/macos/Planar.app /Applications/Planar.app && codesign --force --deep -s - /Applications/Planar.app
scripts.check:syntax: node --check ui/app.js && node --check scripts/preview.mjs && node --check scripts/check-hygiene.mjs
scripts.lint:ui: biome lint ui scripts && npm run check:syntax
scripts.lint: npm run lint:ui && npm run lint:rust
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run check:hygiene && npm run test && npm run test:hooks
